newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA GOALKEEPER FERRON OUT FOR THREE MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA GOALKEEPER FERRON OUT FOR THREE MATCHES.

text.p: Sampdoria goalkeeper Fabrizio Ferron is expected to miss three Italian league matches after injuring ligaments in his left knee.
The Genoese serie A club said medical tests showed Ferron's injury, sustained in a match against Cagliari on Sunday, was less serious than first feared.
But Ferron would still need to wear a cast for 10 days before beginning physiotherapy on the knee.
Sampdoria are second in the league, two points behind Juventus.

The club said Italian under-21 reserve goalkeeper Matteo Sereni, who played four first team matches last season after both Walter Zenga and reserve Angelo Pagotto were sidelined, would replace Ferron.
